FGO_RELIC_SUITCASE.title: Suitcase
FGO_RELIC_SUITCASE.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]20%[/blue] [gold]NP[/gold].
FGO_RELIC_SAINT_QUARTZ.title: Saint Quartz
FGO_RELIC_SAINT_QUARTZ.description: Each room entered increases the counter by [blue]1[/blue]. At counter ≥ [blue]3[/blue],[gold]right-click[/gold]this relic to gain a [gold]random[/gold][gold]Noble[/gold] card, consuming [blue]3[/blue] counter.
FGO_RELIC_SAINT_QUARTZ.flavor: A rare holy crystal used to summon Heroic Spirits.
FGO_RELIC_SUMMON_TICKET.title: Summon Ticket
FGO_RELIC_SUMMON_TICKET.description: Each room entered increases the counter by [blue]1[/blue]. At counter ≥ [blue]3[/blue],[gold]right-click[/gold]this relic to choose a [gold]Noble[/gold] card to add, consuming [blue]3[/blue] counter.
FGO_RELIC_SUMMON_TICKET.flavor: A ticket carrying hope and wishes for a summon.
FGO_RELIC_HALLOWEEN_ROYALTY.title: Mystic Code
FGO_RELIC_HALLOWEEN_ROYALTY.description: Every [blue]5[/blue] turns, use [gold]Mystic Code[/gold]'s [gold]Master skill[/gold]. Every [blue]5[/blue] turns, use [gold]Mystic Code[/gold]'s [gold]Master skill (+)[/gold].
FGO_RELIC_HALLOWEEN_ROYALTY.flavor: A prestigious and noble product. Now you can be the (Halloween) Crown Prince!
FGO_RELIC_COMMAND_SPELL.title: Command Spell
FGO_RELIC_COMMAND_SPELL.description: [gold]Command Spells[/gold] are the three absolute commands which can be used with [gold]right-click[/gold] in battle.
FGO_RELIC_COMMAND_SPELL.flavor: Command Spells are extremely powerful magic granted to each Master.
FGO_RELIC_SURPRISE_CHOCOLATE.title: Surprise Chocolate
FGO_RELIC_SURPRISE_CHOCOLATE.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] random buff.
FGO_RELIC_SURPRISE_CHOCOLATE.flavor: The first time seems like just an attempt... let's do it again!
FGO_RELIC_LOCK_CHOCOLATE.title: Lock Chocolate
FGO_RELIC_LOCK_CHOCOLATE.description: Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} at the start of your turn. At the start of combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Evil Curse[/gold].
FGO_RELIC_LOCK_CHOCOLATE.flavor: Make a choice and give it to someone important to you.
FGO_RELIC_LOCK_CHOCOLATE_STRAWBERRY.desc: Upon pickup, add a [gold]Wall of Snow Flakes[/gold] and [gold]Black Barrel[/gold] to your deck.
FGO_RELIC_LOCK_CHOCOLATE_STRAWBERRY.flav: Carefully select the recipient of the gift.
FGO_RELIC_STARGAZER_TEAPOT.title: Stargazer Teapot
FGO_RELIC_STARGAZER_TEAPOT.description: Whenever you use a potion, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Guts[/gold].
FGO_RELIC_STARGAZER_TEAPOT.flavor: Drink it and deepen the bonds.
FGO_RELIC_LEYLINE_STONE.title: Leyline Stone
FGO_RELIC_LEYLINE_STONE.description: When you are about to be killed, avoid death, restore to [blue]100%[/blue] of max HP, and gain [blue]300%[/blue] [gold]Noble Phantasm Gauge[/gold]. (Only effective once)
FGO_RELIC_BLESSED_LOCK_ON_CHOCOLATE.desc:
Upgrades Mash's cards after defeating Bosses.
Act [blue]1[/blue] Boss: NP upgrades to [gold]Lord Camelot[/gold], Wall of Snowflakes upgrades to [gold]Venerated Wall of Snowflakes[/gold], gain [gold]Obscurant Wall of Chalk[/gold].
Act [blue]2[/blue] Boss: NP upgrades to [gold]Lord Chaldeas[/gold], Wall of Snowflakes upgrades to [gold]Venerated Shield of Snowflakes[/gold].
FGO_RELIC_POISON_APPLE.title: Poison Apple
FGO_RELIC_POISON_APPLE.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Block[/gold], apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to a random enemy.
FGO_RELIC_POISON_APPLE.flavor: An apple that looks suspicious no matter how it looks. The person who takes this and is willing to eat it must be a super good person.
FGO_RELIC_MISO_POTATO.title: Miso Potato
FGO_RELIC_MISO_POTATO.flavor: Smuggled from the ZHIFU Mountains and circulated as simple food on the black market.
FGO_RELIC_FAN_NIGHT.title: Fan Night
FGO_RELIC_FAN_NIGHT.description: Whenever you break an enemy's [gold]Block[/gold] the first time each combat, heal for [blue]20%[/blue] of your MAX HP.
FGO_RELIC_DOUBLE_MUSCLE_BURGER.title: Burger King
FGO_RELIC_DOUBLE_MUSCLE_BURGER.descripti: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]40[/blue] and obtain a unique [gold]Curse[/gold].
FGO_RELIC_DOUBLE_MUSCLE_BURGER.flavor: Since protein can be converted into muscle, that's definitely 0 calories.
FGO_RELIC_DREAM_CHIP.title: Dream Chip
FGO_RELIC_DREAM_CHIP.description: Whenever you shuffle your [gold]draw pile[/gold] the first time each combat, add a [gold]Calculated Gamble[/gold] into your [gold]hand[/gold].
FGO_RELIC_DREAM_CHIP.flavor: A luxurious casino chip carrying dreams.
FGO_RELIC_COSMIC_MEDALLION.title: Cosmic Medallion
FGO_RELIC_COSMIC_MEDALLION.description: Whenever you lose HP during your turn, gain double that amount in [gold]Block[/gold].
FGO_RELIC_MIDSUMMER_NIGHT_DREAM.title: Midsummer Night Dream
FGO_RELIC_MIDSUMMER_NIGHT_DREAM.descript: You can no longer become [gold]Evil Curse[/gold].
FGO_RELIC_MIDSUMMER_NIGHT_DREAM.flavor: While these visions did appear. And this weak and idle theme, no more yielding but a dream.
FGO_RELIC_SALEM.title: Salem
FGO_RELIC_SALEM.description: For each [gold]Foreigner[/gold] card: at the start of your turn, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold] and [gold]Crit Stars[/gold].
FGO_RELIC_SKULL_CANDY.title: Skull Candy
FGO_RELIC_SKULL_CANDY.flavor: Candy that has been resold multiple times.
FGO_RELIC_ARCHETYPE_O_R_T.title: Archetype ORT
FGO_RELIC_ARCHETYPE_O_R_T.description: Converts your [gold]Invincibility[/gold] to [gold]Anti-Purge Defense[/gold]. At the start of your [blue]2nd[/blue] turn and after each turn, gain [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Stars[/gold] and [blue]3%[/blue] [gold]NP[/gold].
FGO_RELIC_ARCHETYPE_O_R_T.flavor: A lifeform created (designed) by fusing ORT's heart with an extraterrestrial species.
FGO_RELIC_OBLIVION_CORRECTION.title: Oblivion Correction
FGO_RELIC_OBLIVION_CORRECTION.descriptio: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]30%[/blue] [gold]Critical[/gold].
FGO_RELIC_OBLIVION_CORRECTION.flavor: While humans are forgetful creatures, Avengers never forget.
FGO_RELIC_SELF_REPLENISHMENT_MAGIC.title: Self-Replenishment (Magic)
FGO_RELIC_SELF_REPLENISHMENT_MAGIC.descr: At the start of each turn, gain additional [blue]6%[/blue] [gold]NP[/gold].
FGO_RELIC_SELF_REPLENISHMENT_MAGIC.flavo: Mana continues to surge forth until vengeance is complete.
FGO_RELIC_B_B.title: BB
FGO_RELIC_B_B.description: At the start of each combat, gain a buff or debuff. Buff: gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Debuff: gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], [gold]Frail[/gold] or [gold]Weak[/gold].
FGO_RELIC_BOW_INSIGNIA.title: Bow Insignia
FGO_RELIC_BOW_INSIGNIA.description: Unlock the [gold]Unlimited Blade Works[/gold] [gold]Noble Phantasm[/gold] card.
FGO_RELIC_BOW_INSIGNIA.flavor: A seal engraved with the Archer emblem.
FGO_RELIC_MECHANICAL_PROTECTOR.title: Mechanical Protector
FGO_RELIC_MECHANICAL_PROTECTOR.descripti: Whenever you play a [gold]Power[/gold] card for [blue]3[/blue] times, a random enemy is [gold]Stunned[/gold]. This relic has been used up.
FGO_RELIC_MECHANICAL_PROTECTOR.flavor: Uses a special structure to assist the bending of the joints.
FGO_RELIC_II.title: II
FGO_RELIC_II.description:
Whenever you play [gold]Goddess Sugar[/gold], gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Affection[/gold].
If it is the first card played this turn, gain +[blue]2[/blue].
While on [gold]Waterside[/gold], gain +[blue]10[/blue].
Affection resets to [blue]0[/blue] at the start of combat.
FGO_RELIC_II.flavor: The second gift she gave you.
FGO_RELIC_ASTRAL_SWORD_EPITAPH.title: Astral Sword Epitaph
FGO_RELIC_ASTRAL_SWORD_EPITAPH.descripti: The default [gold]Affection[/gold] of [gold]II[/gold] becomes [blue]10[/blue] (the start of combat sets it to [blue]10[/blue] instead of clearing it).
FGO_RELIC_ASTRAL_SWORD_EPITAPH.flavor: A Star Sword buried at the edge of the universe.
